visual_observation: The rendered panel visibly says "Finish setting up your profile" and "Add a photo to get the most from your account." It presents visible "Add photo" and "Not now" controls.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the live rendered text matched the panel copy and there were two visible, enabled BUTTON elements with text "Add photo" and "Not now".
transition_observation: Activated the in-scope "Not now" control once. The same panel text and both controls remained visible afterward; no dismissal or other visible state change occurred.
justification: The interface solicits a profile photo by asserting account benefits while offering a dismissal control that did not visibly dismiss the prompt when activated. The persistent prompt and ineffective dismissal support a DECEPTIVE classification.

visual_observation: The rendered panel visibly says "Profile quest", shows "LEVEL 2", and says "Complete service details to earn points and unlock the next level." A visible "Complete next quest" control is present.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the live rendered text matched the panel copy and there was one visible, enabled BUTTON element with text "Complete next quest".
transition_observation: Activated the in-scope "Complete next quest" control once. The same panel text, level indicator, and button remained visible afterward; no visible transition occurred.
justification: The interface frames completion of service details as a quest and ties it to points and level progression, applying reward/progression pressure to the requested action. The unchanged state after activation adds no benign completion signal, so the visible evidence supports a DECEPTIVE classification.
